comparison.objective: Mix a cloudy insulin vial by rolling it ten full turns without lifting it from the mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled repeated rolling with continuous support contact and turn counting.
comparison.success_condition: Ten full turns occur while the vial remains on the mat; spill, speed, and mixing thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Shared rotational motion is generic: vial rolling tests continuous supported mixing, whereas the candidate tests fine collar adjustment, setscrew locking, and resultant carriage dynamics.
